concerns.text: Phase 7 (T045–T050) introduces 'Cross-Cultural Stylometric Validation' and 'open-ended reader reflections' which have zero basis in spec.md or plan.md. The spec defines ReaderResponse only with empathy/moral scores (US-4). This task set violates the constraint that tasks must not introduce unapproved scope or data models not present in the spec.

T030 strictly forbids implementing a survey interface and mandates fetching a 'validated proxy dataset' from an external source. This contradicts spec.md US-4 which explicitly allows 'human participants (or a validated proxy simulation)' and includes an acceptance scenario where 'a participant completes the reading and the survey'. The task silently removes the 'human participant' option, weakening the spec's requirement.

T010 describes a validation test against a 'set of 10 stories' (referencing the independent test in US-1). However, spec.md SC-001 explicitly requires measuring against a 'manually annotated gold-standard subset of 50 stories'. The task's deliverable (10 stories) falls short of the success criterion (50 stories) required by the spec, constituting a constraint violation.

T046 assumes the existence of 'open-ended reader reflections' in the dataset to parse. Neither spec.md (US-4) nor the data model in plan.md defines a field for free-text reflections in ReaderResponse. This task relies on a data dependency that does not exist in the spec, violating the constraint that tasks must not silently relax or alter the data model defined in the spec.
